title: Formula Sheet & Laws of Exponents Cheat Sheet
objectives: Quickly review all 7 laws of exponents, rationalisation formulas, and real number classification

blocks.heading: The 7 Laws of Exponents (for a > 0, b > 0)
blocks.content:
| Law | Formula | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Product of Powers | $a^m \cdot a^n = a^{m+n}$ | $2^3 \cdot 2^4 = 2^7 = 128$ |
| Quotient of Powers | $a^m / a^n = a^{m-n}$ | $5^6 / 5^4 = 5^2 = 25$ |
| Power of a Power | $(a^m)^n = a^{mn}$ | $(3^2)^3 = 3^6 = 729$ |
| Power of a Product | $(ab)^n = a^n \cdot b^n$ | $(2 \times 5)^3 = 2^3 \times 5^3 = 1000$ |
| Power of a Quotient | $(a/b)^n = a^n / b^n$ | $(3/4)^2 = 9/16$ |
| Negative Exponent | $a^{-n} = 1 / a^n$ | $4^{-2} = 1/16$ |
| Fractional Exponent | $a^{p/q} = \sqrt[q]{a^p} = (\sqrt[q]{a})^p$ | $27^{2/3} = (\sqrt[3]{27})^2 = 3^2 = 9$ |

blocks.heading: Surds & Rationalisation Identities
blocks.content:
• $(\sqrt{a} + \sqrt{b})(\sqrt{a} - \sqrt{b}) = a - b$
• $(a + \sqrt{b})(a - \sqrt{b}) = a^2 - b$
• $(\sqrt{a} + \sqrt{b})^2 = a + 2\sqrt{ab} + b$
• $\sqrt{ab} = \sqrt{a} \sqrt{b}$ and $\sqrt{a/b} = \sqrt{a} / \sqrt{b}$

blocks.heading: Critical Board Trap
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Trap:** Is $\pi = 22/7$? NO! $22/7$ is merely an approximation. $\pi$ is an **irrational number** (non-terminating, non-recurring), whereas $22/7$ is a **rational number**!

steps: Step 1: Apply (sqrt(a) - sqrt(b))(sqrt(a) + sqrt(b)) = a - b.

takeaways: Keep this formula sheet bookmarked for high-speed algebra and surd calculation.
a^0 = 1 for any non-zero real number a.
